comments_data.body:
Thanks for this @lebaphi, I have one issue.  If we put a debug line in `getRows()` we see it gets called repeatedly as the Support Panel is resized.

We have already wrapped `getColumns` and `getRows` in `useState`.  I tried switching to `useMemo`, but it didn't help.  I also tried creating `playerForceState` and `forcesState` objects - and only running an update if the new value was different to them.  But, it didn't help.

Could you think about how to reduce the rendering please?

Note: one fallback could be to generate the data in `support panel`.  Hmm, if I move the `useState` to `SupportPanel` - it doesn't get re-generated on each resize activity.

Aaah, I _guess_ we could cache the generated cols/rows in `Planning-Assets`, and only call `setColumns`, `setRows` if the cached values have changed.  But, it _looks-like_ `Planning-Assets` state is all lost on each call.
